layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The pursuit of unified multimodal modeling [6,38,46]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: requires both language and vision to operate on seman-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tically meaningful tokens. While language models have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: long benefited from semantic tokens that naturally sup-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: port both understanding and generation,visual models re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proaches.(a) Low-dimensional token generation:Both meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods operate at the spatial level—autoregressive requires h × w

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ation:Autoregressive becomes intractable (h X w X d steps),and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: standard discrete diffusion cannot model intra-position dependen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cies. Our Cubic Discrete Diffusion performs fine-grained masking

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across the entire 3D tensor—any dimension at any position can be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masked and predicted independently-enabling effcient genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion in T< h ×w ×d iterations while capturing both spatial and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional correlations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main fragmented—using high-dimensional semantic fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures for understanding but low-dimensional compressed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tokens [10,16,41,47,54] for generation．Recent ad-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vances [5,37,53] have shown that high-dimensional rep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resentation features (768-1O24 dimensions） can achieve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-quality reconstruction,offering a path forward.For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: discrete generative models [2,36,39],which share the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: token-based paradigm with language models,adopting such

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-dimensional representation tokens is particularly com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pelling,as it would allow visual generation to leverage the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: same semantic richness that has proven essential for under-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: standing,potentially enabling more coherent unified archi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tectures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The more fundamental challenge lies in modeling such

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-dimensional discrete tokens.While dimension-wise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quantization successfully preserves semantic quality, the re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sulting representation contains h × w × d discrete tokens

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (196.608 for a typical 16 ×16× 768 configuration). As illus-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trated in Figure 1(b),direct sequential generation requires

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: O(hwd) steps,which is intractable,while standard discrete

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diffusion methods cannot capture the dependencies across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensions within each spatial position.To make this prob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lem tractable,we need a method that avoids sequential

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bottlenecks while preserving the rich dependency structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across both spatial and dimensional axes.We observe that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the h×w ×d tensor has inherent multi-dimensional structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that can be exploited—rather than treating spatial positions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as atomic units or requiring sequential generation of all di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mensions,we can break these rigid boundaries and operate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: flexibly across the entire tensor.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figur2.Generatedsamples fromCubiD.Clas-conditioal generatioresultsonImageNet256×256usinghigh-dimensionalrepresen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However,high-dimensional representations pose signif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: icant challenges for discrete generative modeling.The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: first is how to discretize these features while maintaining

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: their representation quality. Traditional Vector Quantiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [41] methods that work well in low dimensions （8-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 32) fail at 768-1O24 dimensions due to the curse of dimen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sionality—data points become sparsely distributed, making

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clustering ineffective,and the codebook size required for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adequate coverage grows exponentially. The quantized fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures inevitably drift from the original representations,cor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rupting the semantic information essential for understand-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing.Dimension-wise quantization [43] offers a promising

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: solution.By treating each dimension independently rather

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: than quantizing entire vectors jointly,it sidesteps the clus-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tering problems in high-dimensional spaces.As a training-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: free method, it can be directly applied to frozen pretrained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features,making discretization tractable at 768+ dimen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sions.We validate this approach on multimodal understand-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing tasks:dimension-wise quantized features achieve nearly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: identical performance to continuous features,while VQ suf-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fers substantial degradation (Table 3). This result confirms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that properly discretized high-dimensional tokens preserve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic quality for understanding tasks,establishing them

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as viable unified representations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We propose Cubic Discrete Diffusion (CubiD)，a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masked diffusion method [1,3,26] for high-dimensional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: discrete generation. Our key insight is to perform fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grained masking across the three-dimensional h × w × d

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensor.Unlike existing methods [3] that mask entire spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: positions,our approach treats this tensor as a unified cubic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: space where any subset of dimensions at any position can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be masked and predicted from partial observations.This al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lows the model to learn complex dependencies both within

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and across spatial locations.As shown in Figure 1(b),dur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing generation,CubiD starts froma fully masked tensor and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: iteratively refines it through progressive unmasking,ran-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domly selecting tokens across the entire tensor to unmask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at each step until reaching the complete representation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This approach offers two main advantages.First,it effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tively models complex dependencies in high-dimensional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensors—learning both intra-position correlations (how di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mensions relate within a spatial location) and inter-position

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: patterns (how features propagate spatially)—through bidi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rectional attention over partially observed values.Sec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ond,it decouples generation complexity from dimensional-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity:unlike autoregressive methods that scale with O(hwd),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our iterative refinement requires a fixed number of steps

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Tregardless of feature dimensionality,benefiting from the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic redundancy inherent in high-dimensional repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations.By transforming an intractable sequential pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cess into hundreds of parallel iterations,CubiD makes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-dimensional discrete generation computationally fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sible while maintaining the modeling capacity necessary for

layout_dets.text: 3.Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ·We demonstrate that proper discretization of high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional representation tokens can preserve their orig-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inal semantic capabilities,establishing the viability of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unified discrete representations for both understanding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Extensive experiments validate our approach．We first

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: verify that dimension-wise quantization preserves both un-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: derstanding and reconstruction capabilities of the original

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: continuous representations.In ablation studies,we compare

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our fine-grained cubic masking against alternative strate-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gies: treating spatial positions or dimensions as groups sig-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nificantly degrades performance,confirming the necessity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of element-wise masking across the 3D tensor. The method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: also exhibits strong scaling behavior from 90oM to 3.7B

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameters and generalizes well across different represen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation encoders (DINOv2 [3O] and SigLIP2 [4O]). On Im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ageNet 256x256 [8],CubiD achieves a competitive 1.88

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: FID score with 768-dimensional discrete tokens,establish-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing that high-dimensional discrete generation is both feasi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble and effective.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our goal is to enable discrete generative modeling of high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional representation tokens from frozen pretrained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoders.This requires two steps:discretizing the contin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uous high-dimensional features,and modeling the result-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing discrete token distribution.We frst review the nec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: essary preliminaries:high-dimensional features from pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained encoders and dimension-wise quantization that en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ables tractable discretization (Sec.3.1). The core chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenge—and our main contribution—lies in modeling the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: joint distribution of the resulting h × w × d discrete to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: kens,an exponentially large space where traditional meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods fail.We propose Cubic Discrete Diffusion (CubiD),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which performs masked prediction across both spatial and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensional axes simultaneously. By masking and predict-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing at the dimension level, CubiD captures complex inter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-quality synthesis.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our contributions are summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ·We propose Cubic Discrete Diffusion,a novel method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that addresses the fundamental modeling challenge of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-dimensional discrete generation by treating the h ×

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: w × d tensor as a unified space with fine-grained mask-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing,making discrete generative models tractable at high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensionality.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: · We achieve state-of-the-art discrete generation results on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ImageNet 256x256,with strong scaling behavior from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 900M to 3B parameters and generalization across dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferent representation encoders,demonstrating the effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiveness of discrete diffusion for high-dimensional visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: NOv2 [30] or SigLIP [4O] features as latents (768+ di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mensions)without any adaptation,and a specially designed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training schedule is applied to these high-dimensional la-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tents to adapt the continuous diffusion models for gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ation.In this paper,we first transform high-dimensional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features from vision foundation models into discrete tokens

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and then train generative models on those tokens.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Visual TokenizationVisual tokenization is commonly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used to convert images into latent representations that sup-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: port image reconstruction and generation.In the traditional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VAE tokenizers [7,16],an encoder first compresses an im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age into a low-dimensional continuous latent map (typically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with 4-32 dimensions) and then a decoder reconstructs the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corresponding image with the latent as input. The encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and decoder of these tokenizers are jointly trained for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reconstruction task.Building on this framework,discrete

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tokenizers further quantize each vector from the latent maps

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: into one or several tokens [10,13,28,43,49,51],enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: discrete image generation．More recently,representation-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based tokenizers [34,52,53] have emerged.Most of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these methods use a frozen pretrained vision foundation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model [3O,4O] as the encoder and further train additional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapters to project its outputs into low-dimensional latents.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In contrast,RAE [53] directly uses high-dimensional DI-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Discrete Visual Generation Discrete visual generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performs image generation based on sequences of discrete

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tokens. Autoregressive models [17,24,31,36, 42, 44, 48]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generate tokens sequentially via the next-token prediction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paradigm.Although these models can generate high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images,they require O(N） generation steps for N tokens,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: making this paradigm computationally expensive for high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution images.To improve sampling efficiency,dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crete diffusion models [3] have been introduced.Instead of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generating tokens sequentially, they generate multiple to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: kens in parallel, thereby achieving higher efficiency. Like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: continuous diffusion models,discrete diffusion models also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn to restore corrupted tokens, with corruption defined by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: absorbing-state [3,26,29,45],uniform[1],or Gaussian-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: like transitions [1,26].Among these,the absorbing-state

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transition is the predominant choice due to its strong em-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pirical performance [29]. It corrupts tokens into a special

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [MASK] state,aligning with representative masked gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: Model Architecture.CubiD employs a standard Trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concatenate them into a d-dimensional feature vector. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results in a sequence of h × w tokens,each with dimension-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ality d. The Transformer processes this sequence through

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bidirectional attention,with the sequence length remaining

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fixed at h × w regardless of feature dimensionality. Each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: output token from the Transformer is passed through an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MLP-based prediction head that produces d × L logits,en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: abling simultaneous prediction of all d dimensions at that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial position. This design decouples computational com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Inference.During inference,CubiD generates images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through iterative refinement starting from a fully masked

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensor.As illustrated in Figure 4,the model begins with all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: til reaching a complete image (loo%).At each iteration t,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model predicts all masked tokens simultaneously and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unmasks a subset randomly. Motivated by MaskGIT [3],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the number of tokens to unmask follows a cosine sched-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ule.The schedule ensures a coarse-to-fine generation pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cess where early iterations establish overall structure and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: later iterations refine details. Crucially, the parallel nature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of our approach means generation requires only O(T) itera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions—typically hundreds of steps-regardless of the tensor

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensionality d,making high-dimensional discrete gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ation computationally feasible.
